name: auklet-forms-selfhost
description: Self-hostable form-to-email endpoint for Cloudflare Workers. Honeypot spam trap, CORS allow-list, Resend delivery. Single file, no database.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your [Resend](https://resend.com/api-keys) API key (starts with `re_`). Create one with "Sending access".

TO_EMAIL.description: Where submissions are delivered. One address, or up to 10 separated by commas. While testing with the default sender, this must be the email you signed up to Resend with.
